title: Reading the first input bit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $x,pre,rest,a$ be Boolean words, let $b$ be a Boolean, and suppose $x=pre\mathbin{++}[b]\mathbin{++}rest$. One step of the constructed machine from the parsing state at input position $|pre|+1$, with first buffer $a$, empty second buffer, head positions $|a|$ and $0$, and empty output, advances the input head to position $|pre|+2$ and enters the parsing state with $b$ pending; the buffers, head positions, and output remain unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
